claims.text: Topical retinoids (tretinoin, tazarotene, adapalene, trifarotene) are contraindicated in preg
claims.quote: Topical retinoids, such as tretinoin, tazarotene, adapalene, and trifarotene, should be included in the initial management for most patients with acne, although their use is contraindicated during pregnancy.

claims.text: Tetracycline-class abx are contraindicated in preg, breastfeed and children age 9 or younger (permanent enamel hypoplasia or tooth discoloration)
claims.quote: Tetracycline-class antibiotics are contraindicated during pregnancy and breastfeeding and in children age 9 or younger due to the risk of permanent enamel hypoplasia or discoloration of developing teeth.

claims.text: PO cephalexin or cefadroxil: second-line after failed tetracyclines; useful in preg pts w inflam acne
claims.quote: Second-line agent for patients who have failed tetracyclines; useful in pregnant patients with inflammatory acne
